about: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/supply_chain.py (north star 34.2-10, 34.2-17, 34.17-6). A licence entry clears one package whose licence (exactly as the SBOM reads it) is not permissive or not machine-readable; an advisory entry clears one advisory id (or an alias) for one package. Every entry names why, who reviewed it and until when; after `until` it no longer counts and the gate fails again. Entries carried over from THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md are the project's existing record and still need the release lead's confirmation before the public 1.0 (amendment A19).
